positions.title: Software Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Designed web apps for BaseSpace (basespace.illumina.com), Illumina's cloud genome-sequencing platform
Eliminated human touchpoints in array manufacturing software by integrating ERP and automating robot software
Refreshed usability for an assay on Illumina’s custom assay design tool (designstudio.illumina.com)

positions.title: Residential Computing Consultant
positions.description:
Provided computer and network support to students, staff, and faculty using Footprints across all six UCSD colleges
Wrote a webtool in PHP to expedite inventory checkout

projects.title: Famo.us-Angular Router
projects.description:
Introduced Famo.us powered state-machine driven transitions to Famo.us-Angular by building FA-Router with guidance of the creator of the Famo.us-Angular framework
Demonstrated custom Famo.us transitions in an example Famo.us-Angular app
Unit-tested the providers, services, and directives for FA-Router via Karma/Jasmine
Created landing page for project using FA-Router to demonstrate its potential
Received interest in contributing to project from other Famo.us-Angular developers

projects.title: Mojsart
projects.description:
Led a small team in building an app that facilitates music categorization and visualization through crowdsourcing sentiment (mojsart.com)
Created custom Angular directives to integrate d3.js into the front-end visualization
Integrated client-side app with Node back-end using socket.io and Express
